open_points.subject: R0-87 audit history after retention erasure
open_points.text: “When it was archived and when it was anonymised, the audit log says.” conflicts with “every entry older than the date the owner gives is gone” (R0-66).
open_points.question: After the owner erases old audit entries, must Registry still be able to say when the project was archived and anonymised?
options: The dates disappear when their audit entries are erased.
These audit entries are exempt from erasure.
The dates also remain as non-audit facts on the anonymised project.
open_points.default_guess: The dates are available only while their audit entries remain; R0-66 may erase them.
